rows.corpus_definition: To be careful because of a possible danger.
rows.example_en: Beware of the dog when entering the yard.

rows.corpus_definition: to offer a specific amount of money to buy something
rows.example_en: She placed a high bid for the rare painting.

rows.corpus_definition: To tie objects together using rope or string.
rows.example_en: They used rope to bind the wood together.

rows.corpus_definition: A strong and sudden explosion of energy or wind.
rows.example_en: The loud blast broke the nearby windows.
They had to blow up the old bridge.

rows.corpus_definition: A close connection or strong feeling of friendship between people.
rows.example_en: They share a special bond after working together years.

rows.corpus_definition: Extra money given for doing a very good job.
rows.example_en: The staff received a holiday bonus.

rows.corpus_definition: A line that marks the edge of an area.
rows.example_en: The river forms a boundary between the countries.

rows.corpus_definition: To talk too proudly about your own achievements.
rows.example_en: He likes to brag about his expensive car.

rows.corpus_definition: The quality of showing courage in dangerous situations.
rows.example_en: The soldier was honored for his bravery.
